_notes.budget: EGP 50,000 and EGP 500 max loss a trade are starting values: change them to yours.
_notes.fee_pct: 0.05 % each way, a conservative guess: Telda says it charges no commission, but EGX and regulator charges (about 0.01 % each) may apply. Set it from Telda's fee page.
_notes.same_day_list: Empty: every buy warns. Fill it with EGX's current same-day (T+0) list from egx.com.eg or Telda, and day trades in anything else are blocked.
_notes.paper: true: tickets say do NOT enter them. Set false only when you choose to trade real money.
